title: Specify Fleet lease and provider fencing
description: Define lease renewal, expiry, revocation, Binding.fence increment, Agent.session rejection, provider fencing, prepare/commit/reconcile, no silent partial lease, and partition/failure semantics against the accepted kernel contract.

logs.msg: Unblocked by accepted kernel contract. Specify renewal, fence increment, prepare/commit messages, partition recovery, and Binding close-versus-fence. Do not introduce NodeIncarnation or FenceToken; use Binding.fence and Agent.session.
